member.para: The case on record. "Die Cyber-Brutzellen" (2026-08-01): the announcement at 7:01:30 fell 27.3 to 43.0 s into a 44.2 s window and came out as a single two-word segment reading "Kapitel 40" at p=0.59, while all ten refinement probes over the same audio read "Kapitel 14", one of them at p=0.99.

The case the sequence guard had to make an exception for. "Atlan" (build 392, 2026-08-24): one probe window produced two chapter matches on one announcement, the second of them a segment whose timestamps ran ten seconds past the window's end, and both were marked at 2:28:25.26. All three refinement probes over the phantom read "Kapitel 5" - the right answer, and refused, because chapter 5 had been accepted one second earlier at that same position. The book then lost its chapter 6 entirely; see 's notes for the rest of that run.
